{"id":"fedistract-xzkb.17","title":"String-typed enumerations force caller validation","description":"Multiple API types use String where an enum would prevent invalid states at compile time:
- visibility field (mastodon_api Status, funkwhale TrackResponse/CreateTrackRequest, bookwyrm PlaylistResponse) accepts arbitrary strings but only 'public'/'unlisted'/'private'/'direct' are valid
- SetReadingStatusRequest.status (bookwyrm_api.rs:138) accepts any string but only 'to-read'/'reading'/'read' are valid per reading_stats() in books_db.rs
- RateBookRequest.rating (bookwyrm_api.rs:144) is i32 but only 1-5 is valid -- no validation documented
- Status.language (mastodon_api.rs:27) and media_type (mastodon_api.rs:69) are Strings
Each of these forces every downstream server to write the same validation boilerplate. This is the 'defensive-code-forcing' anti-pattern.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-07-21T04:20:38.443785222Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-07-21T04:20:38.443785222Z","labels":["review"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"fedistract-xzkb.17","depends_on_id":"fedistract-xzkb","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-07-21T04:20:38.46305788Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}

new_value: Deferred: adding enums for visibility/status/rating would require updating all 3 servers + DB layer simultaneously. Current string validation at handler level is adequate. Revisit when refactoring to typed API crates.
